newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus March same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus March same-store sales rise.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc Thursday said same store sales for the five-week period ended April 5 rose 3.1 percent from the same five-week period in 1996.

In a statement, Cost Plus said March sales reflect the effect of an earlier Easter, resulting in less holiday shopping days during the period compared with last year. Same store sales for the nine-week period ended April 5, 1997 increased 5.0 percent.
Total sales for the five-week period ended April 5, were $19.9 million, a 17.1 percent increase from $17.0 million for the five-week period ended April 6, 1996.
Year-to-date, total sales for the nine-week period ended April 5, were $34.5 million, a 21.5 percent increase from $28.4 million for the nine-week period ended April 6, 1996.
The company operated 60 stores compared with 50 stores as of April 6, 1996.
